note: Written by the evening check (Claude). Own words, verified facts only, each with its source. Display only: no entry or exit rule reads this file.

market.summary: India fell on Monday after its best week in six months: Nifty 50 -1.11% to 22,889 and Sensex -876 points, led by private banks and IT, with almost three stocks falling for every one rising. The global backdrop was weak too: on Friday the Nasdaq lost 2.1% on worries about how AI spending gets financed, and Brent stays near $108. Tuesday 20 Oct is a market holiday (Dussehra), so the next session is Wednesday 21 Oct, when the Jio Platforms IPO also opens. For the holdings: a headwind for all four, softest for HCLTECH, which held flat while IT fell; the engine's NIFTY 500 check stays RISK-OFF, so drifts fail more often and new positions should be small.

points.text: Nifty 50 closed 22,888.95 (-1.11%), Sensex 73,852.90 (-876 pts); Nifty Private Bank about -1.9%, IT -1.3%, FMCG -1.4%; PSU banks +2.5% were the only gainer. Breadth: 2,925 shares fell, 1,163 rose.

Result reactions today: Axis Bank -4.2% (profit narrowly missed), LTIMindtree -2.8% (profit miss), UltraTech -2.4%, ICICI Bank -1.15% despite a better-than-expected profit; PNB +4.8%, Union Bank +5.3%.
US on Friday 16 Oct: S&P 500 -1.09%, Nasdaq -2.14%, Russell 2000 -1.72%, Dow -0.34%; the tech sector fell over 3% on AI-financing worries (CoreWeave's debt) and higher yields after the hot CPI print.
Brent about $108.6 a barrel (-1.2% after Trump waived some Russia sanctions, but Middle East tension keeps it high); the rupee slipped 3 paise to 94.92 per dollar, ending a six-day rise.
NSE provisional flows for 19 Oct: FIIs net sold about Rs 1,149 Cr, DIIs bought about Rs 3,201 Cr; over 5 sessions FIIs sold about Rs 8,431 Cr.
Markets are shut on Tuesday 20 Oct (Dussehra); the 2026 exchange holiday list also closes 10 Nov and 24 Nov.

market.watch: Wednesday's open after the holiday; US tech after Friday's AI sell-off; FII selling; Nifty support near 22,800.

HCLTECH.summary: HCLTECH closed flat at Rs 1,379.90 while Nifty IT fell 1.3% and Infosys and LTIMindtree dropped, so it is holding better than its sector. There was no new company filing; brokers are split on value after the run (Nomura's target Rs 1,330 is below the price, Anand Rathi rates it Buy at Rs 1,435). The risk is outside the company: US tech fell hard on Friday. The trade is +0.45R with accumulation volume; nothing changes, the stop stays at 1,225.82 until +1R.

points.text: Close Rs 1,379.90 on 19 Oct (Friday Rs 1,380.00) while Nifty IT fell 1.3%; LTIMindtree -2.8% on a profit miss, Infosys among the Sensex losers.
Nomura raised its target from Rs 1,310 to Rs 1,330 (still about 3.6% below the price).
Anand Rathi upgraded to Buy from Hold with a Rs 1,435 target after Q2, citing AI monetisation and deal wins; the stock is still about 23% below its 52-week high of Rs 1,780.
US tech fell more than 3% on Friday 16 Oct (Nasdaq -2.14%) on AI-spending and financing worries.
Global IT services peers still ended that week higher: Accenture +9.9% and Cognizant +11.5% over 5 sessions (Accenture +2.1% on Friday itself).

HCLTECH.watch: A close at or above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; watch how IT opens on Wednesday after Friday's US tech sell-off.

GROWW.summary: Groww slipped 1.4% to Rs 198.08, just under the 200.80 entry (-0.23R), on lower volume, in a day when financials were the weakest part of the market. There was no new filing or company news since the 16 Oct transcript; US broker peers fell sharply on Friday (Robinhood -4.9%, Interactive Brokers -3.9%). It is still above its 10 and 21-day averages and well above the 188.75 stop. The Jio Platforms IPO opening on Wednesday is a large retail event that could lift broking activity, but that is a possibility, not a fact.

points.text: Close Rs 198.08 (Friday Rs 200.85) on about 2.1 crore shares vs 5.2 crore on Friday; 10-day average Rs 194.88, 21-day Rs 192.99.
US broker peers on 16 Oct: Robinhood -4.9%, Interactive Brokers -3.9%, Charles Schwab -2.3%.
Last news (16 Oct): SEBI restored the final 30-minute VWAP for expiry settlement from 7 Dec; Jefferies kept Buy; Abakkus Flexi Cap raised its stake to 90 lakh shares in September.
The Jio Platforms IPO opens for subscription on Wednesday 21 Oct.

GROWW.watch: A close back above 200.80 and then 204 (box high); +1R at 212.85; stop 188.75.

PREMIERPOL.summary: No new filing, deal or company news since the 10 Oct results; the move is price only. The stock gave back Friday's breakout: -4.9% to Rs 106.04, below the 109.49 entry (-0.79R) and slightly below the result-day low of 106.20, with the stop 105.14 less than 1% away. Volume was lower than Friday's and the 25-session pattern is still accumulation, so this reads as a weak market day rather than heavy selling, but a further dip closes the trade.

points.text: Close Rs 106.04 on 19 Oct (Friday Rs 111.51) on about 4.5 lakh shares vs 7.5 lakh on Friday; 10-day average Rs 105.39.
Last week the stock rose 8.7% (Rs 102.60 to Rs 111.53) after an all-time high of Rs 119.90 on 12 Oct; Markets Mojo puts the P/E at about 31x.
Latest exchange filings are the 10 Oct board outcome and results; nothing filed since.

PREMIERPOL.watch: A close below 105.14 exits; a close back above 109.49 (entry) repairs the setup.

SEJALLTD.summary: The earnings call took place on 19 Oct: Sejal filed its investor presentation in the afternoon and the call recording link at 6:14 pm. Management kept its FY27 targets (revenue growth 25-40%, EBITDA margin about 18%, PAT margin about 10%) and a peak revenue goal of Rs 600-650 Cr by FY28, which backs the strong Q2 numbers. The price stayed soft: Rs 858.20 (-1.4%), below the 879.95 starter entry, on low volume, and the market cap (about Rs 1,000 Cr) sits right at the minimum. The call recording itself was not heard tonight.

points.text: FY27 guidance kept at 25-40% revenue growth with about 18% EBITDA and 10% PAT margin; capacity expanding in India and the UAE; peak revenue target Rs 600-650 Cr by FY28.
Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 138.09 Cr (+32.8% YoY), EBITDA margin 18.35% (17.03% a year ago), profit Rs 14.42 Cr (+77.6%).
Filed on 19 Oct: investor presentation (2:50 pm) and the link to the earnings call recording (6:14 pm); the PDFs could not be opened from tonight's check.
Close Rs 858.20 (Friday Rs 870.35) on about 88,000 shares; the stop 838.03 is 2.4% below.

SEJALLTD.watch: The call is done, so the plan allows the remaining 2/3 if the call confirms; guidance held, but the price is below entry: a close back above 879.95 would be the better signal. Stop 838.03.
